summary: A pear-shaped diamond pendant in 14K white gold, suspended from a delicate 10K white gold chain with approximately 0.30 CTW of bezel-set diamond accents.
description:
Timeless elegance with a delicate touch of sparkle. A pear-shaped diamond pendant set in 14K white gold hangs from a delicate 10K white gold chain adorned with bezel-set diamonds.

Effortlessly elegant for everyday wear or layering. The diamond stations along the chain total approximately 0.30 CTW. Centre-stone weight and final specifications are confirmed with our atelier.
care: Store separately in a soft pouch. Clean gently with a soft jewellery cloth and avoid harsh chemicals.
shipping: Your specifications, availability, production timing and insured delivery are confirmed with you in writing before payment.
